name: subagent-kit
description: Scoper (Haiku), implementer (Sonnet), reviewer (Sonnet, Opus for risky changes) and shipper (Haiku) subagents, with rules for when the main session delegates to them, an /issue skill that works a GitHub issue through to a PR (or a queue of issues through to a gh-stack stack of PRs), and a /worktree-include skill that writes .worktreeinclude
